## Team Members

See [Who We Are]({{"/doc/getting-started/team.html" | absolute_url }}) for a list of team members and roles.

## Sprints

Following the Continuous Delivery model, our team has sprint cycles starting on Tuesdays and ending on Mondays.

## Meeting Schedule

Listed below are the meetings our team holds throughout a sprint.

| Frequency     | What              | Why                                                                                 | Who                                                      | When                                    | Where           |
|---------------|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|-----------------|
| Before Sprint | Backlog Grooming  | Readies stories for sprint entry                                                    | Product Team, Engr Manager, one Dev                      | Mondays and Wednesdays, 11:30AM-12:30PM | Team Focus Room |
| Before Sprint | Sprint Planning   | Ensures team resources match up with sprint commitments                             | Product Team, Engr Manager, one Dev                      | Mondays and Wednesdays, 11:30AM-12:30PM | Team Focus Room |
| Sprint Start  | Sprint Planning   | Prepares for and commits to work in the next sprint                                 | Dev Team                                                 | Every other Monday                      | Team area       |
| Sprint Start  | Sprint Review     | Demo's work completed in the last sprint, identifies wins and areas for improvement | Dev Team                                                 | Every other Monday                      | Team area       |
| During Sprint | Standup           | Discuss yesterdays and today's work, impediments to work                            | Engr Manager, Dev Leads, QE Leads, Product               | Daily 9:30AM-9:45AM                     | Team area       |
| During Sprint | Bug Scrubs        | Vets and prioritizes bugs                                                           | Dev Team                                                 | Daily 9:45AM-10:00AM                    | Team area       |
| After Sprint  | Release Readiness | Discuss release with and get approval from stakeholders                             | Program, Product, QA, Privacy, Legal, Security, Platform | Per release schedule                    | Slack           |
